//: The traceability chain, as data. artifact-schema.mjs reads this; it hardcodes nothing about the domain.
//provenance: These prefixes were NOT invented here. They are what the lifecycle skills already emit - UC, INV, AC, BR, S, EP, SC, R, FR - and what ac-trace.mjs already parses. Codifying the existing convention costs nothing; inventing REQ-001/UC-001 would have meant rewriting every skill and every example for no gain.

FR.name: Functional requirement
FR.//: A requirement no story implements is a promise nobody scheduled.

NFR.name: Non-functional requirement
NFR.//: Gate 3 criterion 8: every NFR traces to the design element that delivers it.

AC.name: Acceptance criterion
AC.//: AC-1 exists inside every story, so it is never a global id. ac-trace.mjs owns the AC-to-test half of this chain; this tool does not duplicate it.
